title: Sports Arena Quiz
game_overview: North American sports quiz (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, NCAA) with 6,000+ categories and an anti-repeat engine guaranteeing zero repeats across 100,000+ games, custom tags, and multiplayer.
winning_condition: Accumulate the highest total cash winnings by correctly answering sports trivia questions and outperform both AI competitors in the Final Showdown.
losing_condition: Finish the Final Showdown with a lower cash score than either AI competitor.

controls.action: Select categories, choose dollar values, buzz in, and pick multiple choice answers.
Buzz in quickly to answer the active question.
Type answers in Expert Fill-In-The-Blank mode and input wager amounts.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Deep Sports Authenticity: Covering NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, NCAA, and historic American sports milestones with zero repeat fatigue. 2. Scalable Skill Expression: Distinct answer modes (4-choice Standard, 8-choice Hard, Fill-in-the-blank Expert) and 4 AI intelligence tiers. 3. Broadcast Showmanship: Electric arena stage presentation, tense buzzer races, bonus multiplier wagers, and stadium sound effects.
sections.summary: Core foundational pillars of the sports quiz game.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: Players select a difficulty level for AI opponents (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert) and an answer format (Standard 4-choice, Hard 8-choice, Expert typed text). The game progresses through Round 1 (5 categories x 5 clues, $200-$1000), Championship Round (5 categories x 5 clues, $400-$2000 with 2 Bonus Wagers), and the high-stakes Final Showdown. Players read clues, race AI on the buzzer, answer accurately to gain bankroll, and wager smartly to clinch victory.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Tiered Answer Formats: Standard presents 4 options; Hard expands to 8 options with tempting distractors; Expert requires typing the exact name, team, or stat with intelligent fuzzy string normalization. 2. AI Opponent Difficulty Tuning: Easy (slow buzzer, 45% accuracy), Medium (moderate speed, 68% accuracy), Hard (rapid buzzer, 84% accuracy), and Expert (instant reflex, 95% accuracy). 3. Dynamic Infinite Sports Question Bank: Procedural and expansive multi-era sports trivia engine spanning Football, Basketball, Baseball, Hockey, College Sports, and Legends. 4. Buzzer Timing & Lockout: A countdown light system opens the buzzer; buzzing too early incurs a micro-lockout, while rapid reflexes give first answer rights. 5. Bonus Wagers & Final Showdown: Strategic wager system allowing calculated bets based on category confidence.
sections.summary: Key interactive systems and answer modalities.

sections.title: Movement & Scrolling Alignment
sections.content: Scrolling Axis: Static single-screen TV studio broadcast view with smooth modal overlays. Asset Orientation: All contestant podiums face forward toward the viewer. Movement Physics: UI transitions with snappy easing and podium LED score counters. Camera Behavior: Fixed broadcast camera framing the scoreboard, clue display, and podiums.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Layer Separation: Studio backdrop features deep stadium navy and floodlight stadium bokeh. The central trivia board and active clue modal pop out with high-contrast gold borders, crisp typography, and luminous digital displays. Obstacle Affordance: Buzzer activation lights glow bright cyan/gold when ready and red during lockout.
sections.summary: High contrast stadium broadcast UI layering.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content: Contestant Podiums: Player in the center flanked by 2 distinct AI contenders (e.g., 'Coach Dave' and 'Stats Riley') with animated status cards, fluctuating avatar expressions on correct/incorrect answers, and dynamic live score displays.

sections.title: Fairness Tools
sections.content: In Expert typed mode, robust Levenshtein distance and alias matching forgive minor spelling variations, punctuation, and common nicknames (e.g., 'Brady', 'Tom Brady', 'TB12' are all recognized). Clear buzzer timers and clue read-time pacing guarantee fair buzzer battles.
sections.summary: Player assistance and tolerant answer validation.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Pulsing buzzer indicator lights and dramatic category reveal card flips. State Change Juice: Podiums flash green with rising dollar counters on correct answers, and flash red on point deductions. Impact Juice: Golden confetti particle burst, triumphant stadium organ fanfare on victory, and screen shake on big Final Showdown wagers.

sections.title: Social Mechanics & Audience
sections.content: Geared toward sports enthusiasts and trivia fans of all knowledge levels, with extensive replayability, high score tracking, category accuracy statistics, and career trophies.
sections.summary: Single player competitive trivia for sports fans.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: Large legible font sizes, customizable timer speeds, high-contrast text backgrounds, on-screen virtual keyboard for mobile typed mode, and clear visual and audio buzzer countdown cues.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Main Menu -> Match Setup (AI Difficulty & Answer Mode Selection) -> Round 1 Board -> Championship Round Board -> Final Showdown (Wager & Clue) -> Match Results & Career Stat Summary -> Play Again.
sections.summary: Complete menu, game mode selection, and match flow.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Render on-screen touchable buttons for category picking, big responsive buzzer button on mobile, quick-tap answer choice cards, and custom on-screen alphanumeric keyboard for Expert typed mode.
